# AncestorsQR

> AI family tree builder and legacy platform. Enter your surname and get a custom coat of arms, AI-written family biography, visual bloodline tree, and QR-coded heirloom products that preserve family history.

AncestorsQR turns your surname into ancestry stories, a digital family archive, and ancestry memory pages your descendants can scan generations from now. Not a genealogy database — an emotional identity discovery experience.

## What AncestorsQR helps families do

- **Family tree builder** — AI-generated bloodline tree from a single surname.
- **Ancestry stories & AI family biographies** — 9-chapter narrative of your House, written by AI from your surname's origin, trade, and migration history.
- **Genealogy QR codes** — every heirloom carries a QR code linking to your permanent ancestry memory page.
- **Digital family archive** — a shareable family share page (`/f/:surname`) preserved indefinitely.
- **Oral history preservation** — narrated chapters with ElevenLabs TTS, so the story can be *heard*, not just read.
- **Family legacy platform** — single home for crest, story, tree, certificate, and heirloom orders.

## Questions AncestorsQR answers

- **Where did my family come from?** → Surname origin, region, era, and ancestral role. See [/tools/surname](/tools/surname).
- **Why was my last name changed?** → Immigration anglicization, trade shortening, persecution, and the most likely reason yours shifted. See [/journey/2](/journey/2).
- **Who were my ancestors before immigration?** → AI family biography of the bloodline before crossing. See [/tools/ancestor](/tools/ancestor).
- **What secrets are hidden in my family tree?** → Forgotten name changes, lost trades, unwritten ancestors. See [/journey/3](/journey/3).
- **Can QR codes preserve family history?** → Yes — every AncestorsQR heirloom carries one. See [/shop](/shop).
